purpose: First human-viewable PNG reference asset batch. Public reference only; not yet verified against a retail target build.

assets.notes: PokéSprite documents that the 68x56 box-sprite format began with Let's Go Pikachu/Eevee. This public PNG is retained as a Switch-era visual reference, not claimed as a target-build exact match.
